en.sayed-ali-raza: When Allāh had observed our truth
He sent ignominy to our foe and sent His succour to us
till Islam got established (like the camel) with neck on the ground and resting in its place.
By my life, if we had also behaved like you,
no pillar of (our) religion could have been raised, nor the tree of faith could have borne leaves.
By Allāh, certainly you will now milk our blood (instead of milk) and eventually you will face shame. [1]
